ios.desc:
Record a voice memo, get it back as text. Whisper Memos is a voice recorder that transcribes your recordings and delivers AI summaries straight to your email — in seconds.

Whether you need a dictaphone for quick voice notes, an audio recorder for meetings, or a voice journaling app, Whisper Memos does it all. Just speak, and we turn your voice recording into clean, readable text.

START RECORDING INSTANTLY
-------------------------
Ideas are fleeting. Record audio in a fraction of a second with:
• Lock screen widget — tap once, start speaking
• Apple Watch complication — always one tap away, no unlocking
• Siri, Shortcuts & Action Button — hands-free voice recording

BEST AI SPEECH TO TEXT
----------------------
Choose between two leading speech recognition models:
• OpenAI Whisper — fast and reliable for everyday voice notes
• ElevenLabs Scribe — up to 96.7% accuracy, great for accents and multilingual speech
Transcribe voice memos in over 50 languages. Convert voice to text with near-perfect accuracy.

AI SUMMARIES & CUSTOM PROMPTS
-----------------------------
Every voice note gets an automatic AI summary. Create custom summary tabs with your own prompts — extract action items from meeting notes, organize your thoughts by topic, or format your AI notes however you like.

ADHD-FRIENDLY REMINDERS
-----------------------
Start any memo with "Remind me to..." and it gets pinned to your lock screen until you dismiss it. Perfect for an ADHD brain dump — capture what you need to do the moment it hits you.

VOICE RECORDER THAT TRANSCRIBES
-------------------------------
More than a simple dictaphone or sound recorder. Whisper Memos combines audio recording with powerful transcription and summarization, so you can record and transcribe in one step.

IMPORT ANY AUDIO FILE
---------------------
Already have recordings? Import MP3, M4A, WAV, AAC, FLAC, and OGG files and get audio to text transcription and summaries — just like a live recording.

WORKS EVERYWHERE
----------------
• Apple Watch app with standalone recording — a meeting recorder on your wrist
• Lock screen widget and Live Activity timer
• Offline recording — syncs when you're back online
• Up to 90-minute recordings with no daily limits

THOUSANDS OF INTEGRATIONS
-------------------------
Send your voice note transcription to Notion, Reflect, Todoist, Things 3, Day One, Evernote, Trello, Drafts, iCloud, and thousands more through Zapier.
